cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: The Handoff Already Happened
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility by returning to earlier offers until the task seems to have been assigned all along.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You offered to take over answering. Start with these unanswered wedding invitations, please; use the guest list, not memory.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant answering the door on Saturday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Door work starts with knowing who's expected. Your 'I'll take over' includes confirming that list; please put replies before arrivals.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll greet whoever turns up. I'm not ringing everyone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then mark which guests your greeting covers. You said 'whoever'; check the unanswered names first so we can record that part of your handoff as complete.
